service.description: A payroll reader's payslips of the employers in their scope (PAYROLL_VIEW), newest pay date first, filtered by employer, group, person, employment, run, period, state (withdrawn ones left out unless asked) or kind, or show corrections or historical; with the legacy pay history (historical, by its own key) unless the list is of a run, a group, a state, a kind or corrections. For a caller without PAYROLL_VIEW, or with mine: the caller's own issued slips alone (PEOPLE_SELF_SERVICE; a supplied party never widens it) and their own employments' legacy pay history, historical (P26 review, the user's call of Nov 12, 2026). Each: the person, employer, group, period, pay date, kind, state, gross and net, the slip it corrects and its count of corrections. Refuses a caller with neither (PERMISSION_DENIED).

parameter.name: payslips
parameter.description: payslipId (or legacyKey and historical), organizationPartyId, organizationName, partyId, personName, partyRelationshipId, payrollRunId, groupName, periodText, payDateText, kindText, statusId, state, stateText, isPreview, grossText, netText, correctsPayslipId, correctionCount, issuedDateText

service.description: A payslip as PayslipDetail shows it: for a payroll reader of its employer any slip, for the person their own issued slip alone (a line its term keeps off the payslip left out of their view, never out of the totals). Its header (person, employer, group, period, pay date, kind, state: a preview is payroll's alone and never issued, and one whose sources changed since its run was approved says so), its lines grouped (earnings, deductions, employer costs, other values), each with its amount (on a correction the change, what was paid before and now), its rule and its explanation; the totals; the year to date derived from final and issued slips (the employer's fiscal or the calendar year, this slip added); the correction chain (the original and its corrections, each standing or not) with the net effect; the inputs its run took with their sources; the stored statement; and what the caller may do (issue a final slip, correct). With legacyKey (partyRelationshipId|payDate), a legacy pay record as recorded, never recalculated (a payroll reader's of its employer, or its own person's). Refuses another's slip and a missing one alike (RECORD_UNAVAILABLE).

parameter.name: settlement
parameter.description: Payroll's alone (P27): the slip's obligations (kindText, invoiceId, amountText) and an overpayment it recovers (routeText, amountText, recoveredText, remainingText, invoiceId)

service.description: The caller's own issued payslip (PEOPLE_SELF_SERVICE; no party is taken): payslipId's, else the latest issued; or, with legacyKey (partyRelationshipId|payDate), their own employment's legacy pay record as recorded, historical and never recalculated. Its header, the lines the payslip shows with their explanations, the totals, the year to date (issued pay), its issued corrections (and its original once issued) with the net effect, and the inputs its run took. Never another person's slip or record, a preview, a withdrawn slip or one not issued, whatever the caller's payroll rights or parameters (RECORD_UNAVAILABLE). The person's own SelfService slip and the Assistant's tool (BOSS's AgentToolExposure people_my_payslip, never MCP): the amounts are the person's own, returned to their own session (the user's call of Nov 12, 2026). The stored statement is named (file: its name, type and issue date), never where it is stored: the download reads get#MyPayslipStatement.

The stored statement of the caller's own issued payslip (PEOPLE_SELF_SERVICE), for its screen's download: its location, file name and type. Another person's slip, one not issued and one with no statement are missing ones (RECORD_UNAVAILABLE). Exposed to no Assistant or MCP tool (impl-people P26 review).

A final payslip issued (PAYROLL_VIEW and PAYROLL_EDIT at its employer): its statement rendered once now as the person reads it and stored (its PDF, or its html-print page where the server has no PDF engine), never rendered again; the person told on PayslipIssued (their own accounts alone, direct only; a title naming the employer and the period, never an amount; the link needs a sign-in; no attachment is mailed). Refuses a preview or withdrawn slip (PREVIEW_ONLY: preview mode makes no pay), a slip not final (NOT_FINAL) and another employer's slip (RECORD_UNAVAILABLE). A repeat answers the first issue.

Whether the caller sees a payslip as a record and its files (the payslip content host, get#RecordLinkInfo): a payroll reader of its employer alone (the person reads their own issued slip through get#MyPayslip, never payroll's files of it); canEdit for a payroll editor of the employer. A missing slip and a call with no user are not visible.

A file of a payslip (PayslipContent, the record files of get#RecordLinkInfo): the row, and the uploaded file saved through save#PayslipContentFile. Needs a payroll editor of the slip's employer (check#PayslipAccess: RECORD_UNAVAILABLE outside it, PERMISSION_DENIED otherwise).
Internal to create#PayslipContent, which checks the caller: the file of a PayslipContent row of that slip.
